tldr: Mars through the 4th house brings focus to home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body: Mars transiting the 4th house energizes home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports home base and inner stability: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or retreating into old patterns.
advice: Aim the fire in the 4th house deliberately. Work with home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
